claim_ceiling: Artifact Type Request candidate only; no Criterion Rating type admission, real rating instance, scoring validity or hiring use.

compatibility_analysis.rejection_reason: The selected Measurement Result carrier is for bounded numeric/residuality observables and requires entropy and method fields; it does not preserve one case/rubric dimension, rater, evidence span, or NA/UNK distinction.
An Evaluation summarizes an assessed subject and decision scope; it is not one independently submitted anchored response-dimension judgment with missingness and source evidence.
An Observation can record an event but does not enforce the specific rubric anchor, rater independence, evidence citation and missingness contract of a Criterion Rating.

expiry.condition: Resolved, rejected or superseded by an exact Artifact Type candidate after semantic definition and owner review.

validation_purpose: Validate one rater or scorer judgment on one fairly elicited rubric dimension of one pinned response, preserving source evidence, independence, missingness and exact versions without inferring stable ability.
